title: Dirs/files are missing when scanning on windows after 1.27.12
body:
### What happened?

I use installed SyncTrayzor and setup send-receive drive D: on 2 computers over the internet. I noticed missing files on one computer and after some tests I found that some folders are not even scanned.
I completely removed SyncTrayzor and folder containing the deployed Syncthing and reinstalled. I tested few times and every time after adding the D: drive as shared folder, without even share it at all, SyncTrayzor reported Global and Local State only 405 folders and a number of files.
I found that replacing syncthing 1.28.1 with older version 1.27.12 resulted in SyncTrayzor reporting 
Global State   Files 65,641 Folders 2,107  ~413 GiB
that means 4 times more folders. I am not sure that all folders are detected, but looks much near of the expected size.
If necessary please let me know if I must upload any kind of logs.
Regards,
Ovi

### Syncthing version

v1.28.1

### Platform & operating system

Windows 10 64bit

### Browser version

_No response_

### Relevant log output

_No response_
